import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B62.split("\n"); aas=ls[0].split(); MAT=np.zeros((24,24),dtype=np.int32)-4
code={c:i for i,c in enumerate("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYXBZU")}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): MAT[code[p[0]],code[b]]=int(v)
enc=lambda s: np.array([code.get(c,20) for c in s],dtype=np.int32)
GOP,GE=11,1
def nwmap(a,b):
    la,lb=len(a),len(b); sub=MAT[a][:,b]; NEG=-10**8
    Hprev=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Hprev[0]=0; Hprev[1:]=-GOP-GE*np.arange(lb)
    Dprev=np.full(lb+1,NEG,dtype=np.int64); ptr=np.zeros((la+1,lb+1),dtype=np.int8); ptr[0,1:]=1
    j_ar=np.arange(lb+1)
    for i in range(1,la+1):
        H=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Dcur=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Dcur[0]=NEG
        diag=Hprev[:-1]+sub[i-1]; Dcur[1:]=np.maximum(Hprev[1:]-GOP,Dprev[1:]-GE)
        best=np.maximum(diag,Dcur[1:])
        tmp=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); tmp[0]=-GOP-GE*(i-1); tmp[1:]=best
        I=np.maximum.accumulate(tmp-GOP+GE*(j_ar+1))-GE*j_ar
        H[0]=tmp[0]; H[1:]=np.maximum(best,I[1:])
        p=np.zeros(lb+1,dtype=np.int8); p[0]=2
        p[1:]=np.where(H[1:]==diag,0,np.where(H[1:]==Dcur[1:],2,1)); ptr[i]=p
        Hprev,Dprev=H,Dcur
    i,j=la,lb; ident=0; amap={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        d=ptr[i,j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and d==0:
            amap[i]=j; ident+=(a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif d==1 and j>0: j-=1
        elif i>0: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return 100.0*ident/min(la,lb), amap

accs=["Q9FFN0","Q9LZC5","A0A8T2CSK1","A0A8T2DFL8","A0A8T2D291","A0A8T2D7Q3","A0A2H1ZE56","A0A1P8BG41",
      "A0ABQ7BZK8","A0A3P6A0L4","M4CNJ4","A0ACM8RBX5","M4CNJ3","A0ABC8K2G5","A0A8X7W6K1","A0A0D3AZM3",
      "A0A8X7WP78","A0ACE2DUM8","A0A8T1Z4L6","D7LWU1","A0A9W3DDB2"]
qry=" OR ".join("accession:%s"%a for a in accs)
txt=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
                 params={"query":qry,"format":"fasta"},timeout=60,headers=h).text
seqs={}; org={}
cur=None
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith(">"):
        cur=line.split("|")[1]; seqs[cur]=""
        m=re.search(r"OS=(.+?) (OX|GN|PE|SV)=",line); org[cur]=m.group(1) if m else "?"
    elif cur: seqs[cur]+=line.strip()
print("sequences retrieved:",len(seqs))
q=seqs["Q9FFN0"]; qe=enc(q)
POS={"Ser37":37,"Gln173":173,"Asp328":328,"His331":331}
rows=[]
for a,s in seqs.items():
    if a=="Q9FFN0": continue
    pid,amap=nwmap(qe,enc(s))
    rec={"accession":a,"organism":org[a],"len":len(s),"pct_id":round(pid,1)}
    for lab,p in POS.items():
        jj=amap.get(p); rec[lab]=s[jj-1] if jj else "-"
    rows.append(rec)
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pct_id",ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",240)
print(T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv("UniRef50_Q9FFN0_active_site_conservation.csv",index=False)
print()
for lab in POS: print(lab, dict(T[lab].value_counts()))
n=len(T); labs=list(POS)
cons=[100*(T[l]==q[POS[l]-1]).sum()/n for l in labs]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.2))
ax.bar(np.arange(4),cons,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.bar(np.arange(4),[100-c for c in cons],bottom=cons,color="#cbd5e0")
for i,c in enumerate(cons): ax.text(i,c/2,"%.0f%%"%c,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(["%s\n(%s)"%(l,q[POS[l]-1]) for l in labs])
ax.set_ylabel("percent of homologs with the same residue"); ax.set_ylim(0,110)
ax.set_title("Active site conservation across the UniRef50 cluster of Q9FFN0 (n=%d, all Brassicaceae)"%n)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
